What these are: the debugger console's reply to `SELINFO <reg>`, as `Session.command` returns
it (the screen delta the command produced), recorded raw on 2026-10-21 off a live DOSBox-X,
the scry build f06aa5d26 (macOS, SDL2), driven by the server's own Session through the live
matrix harness.

break-start-cs.txt   `SELINFO CS` at the park `start` makes (the reset vector, real mode,
                     probe.conf): the descriptor is all zeroes.
break-start-af.txt   `SELINFO AF`, a name no segment register has, at the same park: the
                     debugger answers a zeroed descriptor under a blank name (`  : b:...`).
dpmi-client-cs.txt   `SELINFO CS` at the DPMI guest's first INT 31h AH=02h, inside the client
dpmi-client-ds.txt   under CWSDPMI (tests/guest/dpmi.conf): CS 00A7 and DS 00AF, both based
                     at 00400000, with the limit the client's selectors carry.

Not captured: a stop inside CWSDPMI's own 16-bit code. Forty stops of the running guest landed
in the client or in the BIOS, never in the host's code, so that reply has no record here.
Paths are replaced by <dir>.
